# The same route as route_dynamic_body, written as a package window -- a
# `window` at the root of a file rather than one a component body renders.
#
# A window's path parameters arrive as one struct value bound to the slot its
# declaration names, and the reactivity lowering counted every window var as
# mutable state. So the `if` and the `for` over that value became client-side
# render slots: the declarative tree the route's markup is built from was
# gone, the loop stopped coming out as a HoleFor, and the __renderSlotN the
# lowering left behind reached the Go translator as a user function -- which
# panicked on `lower.CreateNode`, an op no language implements.
#
# A route parameter is bound from the URL the request arrived on and nothing
# running in the page can assign it, so it is not reactive and the tree stays
# declarative.

sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out app.sngl

# The conditional is a branch in the handler, not both arms concatenated.
# Unparenthesised: the server is written through format.Source, which drops the
# parentheses a condition is emitted with.
grep 'if v.Pkg != ""' out/server.go
grep 'named' out/server.go
grep 'unnamed' out/server.go

# The loop is ranged in the handler, not flattened into the page.
grep 'for _, row := range' out/server.go

# The route parameter is bound from the request and substituted into the
# redirect, and the whole thing compiles -- which is what a grep over the
# generated Go was never going to say.
grep 'v.Pkg = __r.PathValue\("pkg"\)' out/server.go
grep 'http.Redirect\(__w, __r, "/p/"\+url.PathEscape\(v.Pkg\)' out/server.go
exec go build ./...

# No DOM patching reached the server: the page is written, not mutated.
! grep 'CreateNode' out/server.go
! grep '__renderSlot' out/server.go

-- go.mod --
module pkgwin

go 1.24

-- srv/srv.go --
package srv

type Row struct {
	Name string
}

func Rows(pkg string) []Row { return []Row{{Name: pkg}} }

func Bump(n int) int { return n + 1 }

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "go:pkgwin/srv"
import "sngl:platform/html"

struct PageParams {
    pkg string
}

var hits = 0

window #page(title="t", href=`/p/{pkg}`, params=PageParams{}) {
    html.button(innerText="go", @click { hits = srv.Bump(hits) })
    if v.pkg != "" {
        html.span(innerText="named")
    } else {
        html.span(innerText="unnamed")
    }
    for var row = srv.Rows(v.pkg) {
        html.a(href="/r/" + row.name, innerText=row.name)
    }
}
